question:
A radio announcer can only use words. A TV reporter can show the picture. Same scene, two jobs. Which one tells the story better?

Steps:
1. Start recording. Pick one scene from the list below.
2. Be the radio announcer: describe the scene in 15 seconds using only words.
3. Be the TV reporter: show the scene for 10 seconds using only gestures and facial expressions, and say no more than 5 words.
4. Tell the camera one thing the words did better and one thing the picture did better.

Scene list:
- A thunderstorm seen from a window
- A dog catching a flying disc at the park
- A crowded train platform in the morning
- A surprise party the moment the guest walks in

rubric.description: Student does not perform either version on camera.
Student performs only one of the two versions (radio or TV).
Student performs both versions AND names at least one thing words did better or one thing the picture did better.
Meets all of the above AND names one thing words did better AND one thing the picture did better, each with a specific example from the scene.
